key.name: macos-style
key.description: Enable rounded floating styling and cursor-distance icon magnification.

key.name: macos-magnification
key.description: Maximum extra icon scale near the pointer. 0.55 means a maximum scale of about 1.55.

key.name: macos-magnification-radius
key.description: Distance in logical pixels over which the fish-eye wave influences icons.

key.name: macos-spread
key.description: How strongly neighboring icons move away from the magnified icon.

key.name: macos-animation-duration
key.description: Duration in milliseconds for icon scale and position interpolation.
